C0731.title: Samsung Electronics Chip Secrets Leaked via ChatGPT
C0731.summary: In March 2023, Korean media reported three incidents after Samsung Electronics allowed ChatGPT use in which internal information was entered into an external generative-AI service, involving semiconductor-related code, defective-equipment identification code, and meeting-recording transcription. The incident shows how enterprise adoption of generative-AI tools can create trade-secret leakage risk without sensitive-data input limits, auditing, and employee usage rules.
